Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class InitiateBolusRequestMsg1HistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.InitiateBolusRequestMsg1HistoryLog
public class InitiateBolusRequestMsg1HistoryLog extends HistoryLog
First of three records (292, 293, 343) in which the pump copies the fields of an InitiateBolusRequest received over BLE, written right after BolusRequestedMsg3. Pump-UI and Control-IQ boluses do not write them. Every field matched the request as sent. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 292, so this class name is provisional. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
